```yaml
name: Fuzzing

on:
  push:
    branches: ['**']
  pull_request:
    branches: ['**']

jobs:
  property-tests:
    name: Property-based tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .[dev]
          pip install pytest hypothesis

      - name: Run property tests
        run: pytest -m hypothesis
        timeout-minutes: 5

  atheris-fuzzing:
    name: Atheris fuzzing
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    timeout-minutes: 1
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .
          pip install atheris

      - name: Run Atheris fuzzing
        run: |
          python -m atheris fuzz -c py3plex -t 60s
        timeout-minutes: 1

      - name: Upload fuzzing artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fuzzing-results
          path: fuzzing_output
```
